post.description: Ask a question and get a written answer with citations. `query` is required; `text` includes the source text and `outputSchema` shapes a structured reply. Returns `requestId`, `answer` as prose, `citations[]` with `id`, `title` and `url`, and `costDollars`. Measured at 2.1 seconds with 8 citations. Billed a flat $0.08 per successful request. It sits between a search and a research run: faster and cheaper than `post_exa_agent_runs`, and more direct than reading `post_exa_search` results yourself. `post_perplexity_sonar` answers the same shape of question for $0.012 — reach for Exa when the retrieval needs to be semantic.

query.example: Which manufacturers had the top three global EV sales in 2025?

text.description: Include the full page text of each citation.

type.description: Retrieval mode used to gather sources before answering.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema for a structured answer output.

answer.description: The generated answer. A string, or a structured object when outputSchema was supplied.

costDollars.description: Upstream Exa cost breakdown. Informational only; customer billing is the flat $0.08.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description: Fetch page text and metadata for URLs you already have. `ids` is required and takes the `id` values from `post_exa_search` — which are plain URLs, so any URL works. Toggle `text`, `highlights`, `summary`, `subpages` and `livecrawl`. Returns `results[]` with `id`, `title`, `url`, `author` and `text`, plus a **`statuses[]` array giving per-URL `status` and `source`** — read it, because a URL that could not be fetched is reported there rather than raising. Cached results are served instantly; a miss falls back to a live crawl. Measured at 1.2 seconds. Billed a flat $0.08 per successful request. For a whole site rather than a URL list, `post_firecrawl_crawl`.

ids.description: The URLs (or Exa result ids) to fetch contents for.

summary.description: Return an AI-generated summary of the page.

subpages.description: Number of linked subpages to also fetch.

livecrawl.description: Freshness policy: always live-crawl, fall back to live crawl on cache miss, or never live-crawl.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

post.description: Search the web by meaning rather than by keyword. `query` is required; narrow with `category`, `includeDomains`, `excludeDomains`, `startPublishedDate`, `endPublishedDate`, and set `numResults`. Returns `requestId`, `resolvedSearchType`, `searchTime`, `costDollars` and `results[]` with `id`, `title` and `url`. **`id` is the URL**, and it is what `post_exa_contents` takes. Measured at 1.4 seconds — the fastest search here. Billed a flat $0.08 per successful request. ⚠️ Results carry **no page text** unless you ask: pass `contents`, or follow up with `post_exa_contents`. Choose it over `post_tavily_search` when the query is a description rather than keywords; choose Tavily when you want the text in the same call, and `post_exa_answer` when you want a written answer rather than a list.

query.example: latest evaluation frameworks for AI agents

type.description: Search mode. auto lets Exa choose; the deep modes trade latency for higher-quality retrieval.

category.description: Optional hint about the kind of pages to prioritize.

includeDomains.description: Only return results from these domains.

startPublishedDate.description: Only return results published on or after this ISO 8601 date.

endPublishedDate.description: Only return results published on or before this ISO 8601 date.

contents.description: Content options to return alongside each result.

summary.description: Return an AI-generated summary of the page.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema used to synthesize a structured output from the results.

systemPrompt.description: Instruction that guides how the structured output is generated.

output.description: Structured output, present only when outputSchema was supplied.

costDollars.description: Upstream Exa cost breakdown. Informational only; customer billing is the flat $0.08.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats
